profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments
profile.summary:
I spent 7 years developing software for retirement financial planning before becoming a math teacher in public high schools and academic camps. I enjoy finding interesting puzzles to solve and opportunities to visibly impact someone's well-being. To that end, I'm looking for a mid-level developer position at a company with a focused mission and empathy for its employees and clientele.
  
Specialties:
- JavaScript (React)
- HTML
- CSS (Sass)
- Ruby (Rails & Sinatra)
- Java (J2EE)

positions.title: Apprentice Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Learned and applied object-oriented and test-driven development skills in server-side and front-end environments.
• Collaborated to build a user-friendly Ruby on Rails and ReactJS-based web application using pair programming techniques and Git Workflow.
• Designed and coded a functional, marketable web application as a culminating individual project using ReactJS, React Redux, HTML, and CSS for the front-end and Ruby on Rails with PostgreSQL for the back-end.

positions.title: High School Mathematics Teacher
positions.description:
• Taught Algebra 2 and Geometry classes.
• Designed, developed, and delivered interactive, differentiated lectures aligned with MA
Curriculum Framework using Smart Board technology.
• Met with students and parents in a professional capacity to resolve issues with academic
performance.

positions.title: High School Mathematics Teacher
positions.description:
• Taught Algebra 2, Precalculus Honors; co-taught Geometry Special Prep.
•  Designed, developed, and delivered interactive, differentiated lectures aligned with MA
Curriculum Framework using Smart Board technology.
• Met with students and parents in a professional capacity to resolve issues with academic
performance.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Supervised students aged 12-15 during class periods to actively maintain a safe, respectful classroom environment.
• Prepared and delivered engaging classroom lectures on probability and game theory topics; directed and managed group activities.
• Coordinated with residential life and health office staff to stay apprised of students’ mental and
physical well-being.

*Summers only (June to August)

company.name: Johns Hopkins Center For Talented Youth (CTY)

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
• Built and maintained J2EE applications for use by financial planning advisors in the field.
• Coded Java-based algorithms for modeling the performance of annuity products under Monte Carlo-simulated market conditions.
• Created XSL templates to generate client-tailored financial reports in PDF format using FOP formatting objects and variable XML data.

projects.title: Tab Loom
projects.description:
• Guitar tablature editor with intuitive input controls.
• Front-end UI built using ReactJS with Redux and styled using Bootstrap framework and Sass.
• Back-end built using Ruby on Rails web with PostgreSQL database to manage user and tablature records.
• User authentication/authorization handled with Devise.
• API calls handled with Faraday gem.
• Unit, integration, and endpoint testing done using RSpec with VCR gem.

projects.title: Game Review Hero
projects.description:
• Website for users to post reviews of video games (four-person team project).
• Front-end UI built using ReactJS and styled using Foundation framework and CSS.
• Back-end built using Ruby on Rails web with PostgreSQL database to manage user and tablature records.
• User authentication/authorization handled with Devise.
• Unit and integration testing done using RSpec.
